adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no `topic_id` exists it always enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `embed/loading`. The loading template (`app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`) unconditionally reloads the page every 30 seconds (`setTimeout(... document.location.reload() ...)`) with no terminal error state. If retrieval never creates a `TopicEmbed` (e.g., `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` returns early when `embed_by_username` doesn't resolve to a user, or remote fetch/parsing fails), the client will keep reloading indefinitely and continue triggering repeated requests/job enqueues, creating steady background load without surfacing the misconfiguration/failure.
